verdict.rationale: Abacum documents an Excel Connector that pushes and pulls data between Excel and Abacum, so finance can keep working in Excel. That covers the story's bi-directional Excel requirement through the product's own feature. Evidence is limited to brief marketing lines. missing for 10: detail on add-in form factor and live/refresh behavior, how edit write-back works and is governed, Google Sheets support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, a bi-directional Excel or Google Sheets add-in pulls live data into my spreadsheets and pushes edits back

citations.quote: Push and pull data seamlessly between Excel and Abacum, eliminating copy-paste errors and ensuring everyone's working off accurate numbers.
Keep Excel in use, while leveraging the power of Abacum.
